manual.why: the renderer is a Chromium process inside the running app
manual.steps: Task Manager -> Details -> end the ZAICODE process with --type=renderer while a session works.
manual.expected: The window reloads; sessions cut off show INTERRUPTED, never DONE; a window reload never auto-continues (crash resume skips reloads).

manual.why: needs the packaged app and its root launcher (agents inside ZAICODE are refused this on purpose)
manual.steps: Task Manager -> end the ZAICODE process tree under the launcher while two sessions and one worker run.
manual.expected: The launcher restarts it; cut-off sessions show INTERRUPTED; with After a crash on they continue ~30 s after start, oldest first; the worker starts again with the same engine, project and prompt.

manual.steps: Put Windows to sleep for 10 min with a SCHEDULER entry due during the sleep, then wake it.
manual.expected: Clocks and reset timers show the right time at once; quota is re-read within one sweep; the due entry fires once, or is MISSED when older than the catch-up window.

manual.steps: Disable the network adapter for 60 s while a SAIFREN session answers, then enable it.
manual.expected: The turn fails with the provider's error or retries; the session is not DONE; SAIHOME Routing shows degraded, then healthy.

manual.why: window placement is a GUI action
manual.steps: Start a worker, move it to its own window, minimize it, dock it back.
manual.expected: Same worker, same PTY (the CLI keeps its screen and PID); nothing restarts.

manual.scenario: Kill a worker during SAIMAIL delivery
manual.why: needs a real seat mid-send; SAIMAIL's own soak suite owns delivery atomicity
manual.steps: In a worker, start `saimail-local send` of a large telegram and kill the worker at once.
manual.expected: The telegram arrives once or not at all (never torn); the index tail is either complete or skipped by the reader.
